usageNotes: Use this to modify an existing firewall rule within a cluster-level security group, identified by its zero-based position index. Requires `Sys.Modify` on the root path (`/`). Pass `digest` (obtained from the corresponding GET) to guard against concurrent edits overwriting each other. When `moveto` is supplied, all other body fields are ignored — the rule is repositioned only.

examples.summary: Change an ACCEPT rule in the 'web-servers' security group at position 2 to DROP and add a descriptive comment

params.comment: Temporarily blocking inbound until patch window closes

tips: Fetch the current rule with GET /cluster/firewall/groups/{group}/{pos} first — capture the `digest` field and pass it back to prevent lost-update races.
Use the `delete` param (comma-separated field names) to clear optional fields like `comment` or `source` without touching the rest of the rule.
To reorder a rule without changing its content, supply only `moveto`; all other params are silently ignored by the API.
Security group names must start with a letter and be 2–18 characters matching [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9\-\_]+.
Changes apply to every VM/container and host that references this security group — verify scope before committing in production.
